readme_summary: **IMPORTANT: Starting August 2024, the `master` branch has become the primary integration branch and has become unstable. Please check out a tagged version before compiling production binaries.** For internationalized documentation, see the index at doc/intl. Dogecoin is a community-driven cryptocurrency that was inspired by a Shiba Inu meme. The Dogecoin Core software allows anyone to operate a node in the Dogecoin blockchain networks and uses the Scrypt hashing method for Proof of Work. It is adapted from Bitcoin Core and other cryptocurrencies. For information about the default fees used on the Dogecoin network, please refer to the fee recommendation. To start your journey with Dogecoin Core, see the installation guide and the getting started tutorial.
